falseSynonyms.zh: 造成不等於一般影響 cause 表示某事直接導致結果；affect 只表示產生影響，不一定是唯一或直接原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stress may affect sleep, while a specific medication may cause drowsiness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 損害不等於一般影響 damage 一定帶負面結果；affect 可以是正面、負面或中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A storm can affect transport without necessarily damaging every road.

falseSynonyms.zh: 控制不等於影響 control 表示有能力決定或支配結果；affect 只表示對結果有作用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interest rates affect spending, but they do not completely control every purchase decision.

falseSynonyms.zh: 決定結果不等於產生影響 determine 比 affect 強，表示某因素決定結果；affect 只表示其中一個影響因素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Experience may affect a decision, but it does not always determine it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有關不等於有影響 relate to 只表示有關聯；兩件事有關並不代表其中一件改變另一件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Income may relate to spending patterns, but correlation alone does not show how one affects the other.

falseSynonyms.zh: 涉及／使擔心不等於一般 affect concern 可以表示涉及某主題，或使人擔心；不能一般地代替 cause an effect on。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The rule concerns data privacy, but it may also affect how companies store records.
